“Alexa, put the kettle on”...it’s that simple!

By integrating Alexa voice control, this smart kettle lets you boil water with simple voice commands, making hot beverage preparation effortless. Designed to connect to the Alexa app and speakers, simply ask Alexa to boil, adjust the temperature, or keep the water hot. What’s more, its sleek design and smart functionality mean the Morphy Richards Alexa kettle not only enhances your kitchen’s aesthetics but also fits seamlessly into your smart home ecosystem, turning routine tasks into an easy, tech-savvy experience.

Did you know you can build daily routines with your Alexa? With our Alexa integration, you can easily add boiling the kettle into your morning ritual! Imagine starting your day with a cheerful "Alexa, boil the kettle at 7am", and by the time you get downstairs, your kettle is boiled and ready to be poured? Or picture coming home from work, and activating your Alexa kettle from the Alexa app so that as you walk through the front door, your kettle is boiling while you get ready to settle in for the evening. With this incredible design, whether it’s tea time or you're prepping your next cup of coffee, our Alexa Kettle gives you the gift of time, leaving you with more opportunities to savour the moment!

Looking for a toaster to complement our Alexa Kettle? Check out our range of popular black toasters.

Dimensions: H15.5cm x W21.9cm x D27.3cm
Weight: 1.5kg
Wattage: 1.8 - 2.2kw
